title: Butternut Squash Soup
summary: A silky autumn soup with apple, a little cream and crisp sage.
ingredients: 1 butternut squash (about 3 lb), peeled and cubed

steps: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until soft, 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the squash, apple, 4 cups vegetable broth, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover and simmer until the squash is very tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth with an immersion blender, or in batches in a countertop blender.
Stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream and the nutmeg. Warm through for 2 minutes, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
Fry the sage leaves in a little oil for 1 minute until crisp, and scatter them over each bowl.

title: Brioche French Toast
summary: Custardy in the middle and crisp at the edges.

steps: Set up an assembly line. Lay out the bread and grab a shallow bowl that fits one or two slices.
Whisk the eggs, 1 cup half-and-half, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, the vanilla, cinnamon and salt until smooth.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and melt 1 tablespoon butter.
Dip each slice into the custard and soak for about 5 seconds on each side. Let any excess drip off.
Cook the slices until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Add more butter between batches.
Serve warm with maple syrup and fresh berries.
